svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY
svg.desc: A demoscene cube field: a floor of 378 small glowing cubes in an isometric grid, coloured as one rainbow, rolling in a slow wave under scanlines. CUBIC METRES PER MINUTE presents ULTRA SATISFACTORY on a segment display. A text writer types: a companion app for the factory game Satisfactory, every recipe, building and Space Elevator objective, one click apart; 140 items, 211 recipes (88 alternate), 477 buildings, 5 Space Elevator phases; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt, then python -m streamlit run app/app.py; no install at lukexyz.github.io/ULTRA-SATISFACTORY; unofficial fan project; protection none, it's Apache 2.0. Three signs stand on the floor, one per tab: OBJECTIVES, ITEMS, BUILDINGS.
